UNANIMOUS WRITTEN CONSENT OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS
OF
NORTHWIND HOLDINGS, INC.
Dated as of February 22, 2025

Pursuant to Section 141(f) of the Delaware General Corporation Law and Article III, Section 3.6 of the Bylaws of Northwind Holdings, Inc. (the "Corporation"), the undersigned, being all of the members of the Board of Directors of the Corporation, do hereby consent to and adopt the following resolutions:

APPROVAL OF FY2025 OPERATING BUDGET
RESOLVED, that the FY2025 Operating Budget in the form attached as Exhibit A is hereby approved.

APPROVAL OF SERIES B PREFERRED STOCK FINANCING
WHEREAS, the Corporation proposes to issue and sell up to $18,000,000 of Series B Preferred Stock (the "Series B Financing") to Longbow Capital Partners III, L.P. and other investors identified on Exhibit B;
WHEREAS, the Series B Financing has been reviewed and negotiated by management and outside counsel (Wilson, Frey & Ambrose LLP);
NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED, that the Corporation is authorized to (i) file the Amended and Restated Certificate of Incorporation designating the terms of the Series B Preferred Stock, (ii) execute the Series B Preferred Stock Purchase Agreement, and (iii) issue up to 4,500,000 shares of Series B Preferred Stock at a purchase price of $4.00 per share; and further
RESOLVED, that the Chief Executive Officer, the Chief Financial Officer, and any Vice President of the Corporation is each authorized, acting singly, to execute and deliver such agreements, instruments and certificates as such officer deems necessary or appropriate to consummate the Series B Financing.

RELATED-PARTY TRANSACTION — LEASE FROM K&B PROPERTIES LLC
WHEREAS, K&B Properties LLC is a Delaware limited liability company beneficially owned 50% by Angela K. Beaumont and 50% by Rafael J. Kim (each an interested director);
WHEREAS, the Corporation proposes to lease approximately 14,000 square feet at 220 Merchant Street, Wilmington, DE from K&B Properties LLC for a term of five years at $28.50 per square foot;
WHEREAS, the disinterested directors have reviewed a market-rate survey prepared by Cushman-Ryland dated January 30, 2025 concluding that a fair market rent for comparable space is $27.75 to $31.00 per square foot;
NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED by the disinterested directors that the lease is fair to the Corporation as required by DGCL § 144(a)(3) and is hereby approved.

APPOINTMENT OF INDEPENDENT AUDITOR
RESOLVED, that Fenwick Chen LLP is hereby appointed as the Corporation's independent registered public accounting firm for fiscal year 2025.

DIRECTORS EXECUTING (all five directors):
/s/ Angela K. Beaumont (interested director — recused from Related-Party Lease resolution)
/s/ Rafael J. Kim (interested director — recused from Related-Party Lease resolution)
/s/ Priya Naidu (independent director)
/s/ Simon C. Aldridge (independent director)
/s/ Dr. Helena Vorstman (independent director)
